system_description.narrative_summary: A spike of geopolitical events — notably Trump's announced Russia-Ukraine 'energy ceasefire'/diesel deal and escalating Houthi strikes on Saudi airports — is driving volatility in oil and diesel markets, shipping rates, and aviation safety. Markets, policymakers and firms are responding in real time (price moves, advisories, IMF/central bank watchfulness), creating feedbacks between security incidents, fuel availability/prices, logistics costs and financial market sentiment. The story links political decisions and conflicts directly to energy flows and broader economic stability.
system_description.scope: Global energy supply and trade flows (oil, diesel, LNG), related logistics (tankers, pipelines, refineries, aviation routes), market prices and financial impacts (oil/diesel prices, tanker rates, equities, bonds), key state and non-state actors influencing supply/security (Russia, Ukraine, US/Trump, Saudi Arabia, Iran-backed Houthis), and institutional responses (regulators, IMF, central banks, airlines).
system_description.super_system: Global political-economic system (security, trade and finance)
adjacent_subsystems: Global financial markets and investor sentiment
evidence_headlines: Trump announces Ukraine energy ceasefire with Russia, surprising Zelenskiy
Oil falls on hopes Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire will boost supplies
Houthi strike on Saudi airport kills 12, worst attack on kingdom in a decade
FAA tells US airlines to exercise caution in Saudi Arabia flights, citing safety risks
Oil Tanker Rates Surge Amid Rising Attacks, Longer Voyages
Diesel prices slip after Trump claims ‘energy ceasefire’ in Ukraine war

variables.name: Global crude oil production rate
variables.description: The aggregate rate at which crude oil is produced and released into global markets (barrels per day).

variables.name: Global diesel (middle‑distillate) supply rate
variables.description: The net rate of production, refining and trade of middle‑distillate fuels available to global markets (barrels per day).

variables.name: Global LNG supply rate
variables.description: The volumetric rate at which liquefied natural gas is produced, loaded and delivered into international trade (tons or cubic meters per time).

variables.name: Seaborne oil and refined product shipment rate
variables.description: The flow rate of oil and refined product tonnage moving by sea between origin and destination regions (voyages or barrels per day).

variables.name: Interregional pipeline throughput rate
variables.description: The continuous rate of hydrocarbon volumes transported through pipelines across regions (barrels or cubic meters per day).

variables.name: Refinery capacity utilization rate
variables.description: The proportion of global refinery capacity actively processing crude into refined products at a given time (percent).

variables.name: Global crude and fuel inventories
variables.description: The accumulated stock of crude oil and refined fuel held in storage worldwide (barrels).

variables.name: Tanker fleet operational capacity
variables.description: The available carrying capacity of the tanker fleet not constrained by damage, rerouting or layup (deadweight tons or number of vessels).

variables.name: Tanker freight rate level
variables.description: The prevailing price level for seaborne oil/chemical tanker transportation (time charter or voyage rate indices).

variables.name: Aviation route risk level
variables.description: The assessed level of safety and operational risk for commercial aviation corridors affecting route choices and costs (risk index).

variables.name: Security incident frequency affecting energy/logistics
variables.description: The rate of hostile or disruptive events (attacks, strikes, seizures) that directly impair energy production, transport or terminals (incidents per time).

variables.name: Composite logistics cost index
variables.description: A composite measure of logistical costs for energy and goods including freight, insurance, rerouting and delays (cost per unit).

variables.name: Energy price level (oil and diesel)
variables.description: The market price level for benchmark crude and refined products that signals supply/demand balance (price per barrel or liter).

variables.name: Financial market risk sentiment
variables.description: The prevailing investor and trader risk appetite and volatility expectations related to energy and geopolitical developments (sentiment/volatility index).

variables.name: Aggregate central bank monetary stance
variables.description: The combined monetary policy stance and liquidity provision of major central banks that affects financial conditions (tightening/loosening index).

variables.name: Trade and sanctions restriction level
variables.description: The overall severity and scope of trade measures, sanctions and export controls that constrain energy flows and commercial operations (restriction index).

catalysts.title: Ramp-up of Russian diesel exports under announced deal
catalysts.description: Implementation and shipping of diesel volumes from Russia following the announced US-mediated deal, altering regional diesel flows and inventories.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Trump announces Ukraine energy ceasefire...' ; 'Russia says its diesel exports may exceed volumes announced by Trump'.

catalysts.title: Escalation of Houthi strikes affecting Gulf-Red Sea shipping
catalysts.description: Continued Houthi attacks and missile strikes in the Gulf/Red Sea region that raise risk to oil shipping and force longer voyages/rerouting.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Houthi strike on Saudi airport kills 12'; 'Oil Tanker Rates Surge Amid Rising Attacks, Longer Voyages'; 'Houthis attack Riyadh airport'.

catalysts.title: Riyadh airport closure and sustained aviation disruption
catalysts.description: Extended shutdown of Saudi capital's airport and airline cancellations, sustaining elevated aviation-route risk and near-term logistical strain.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Saudi capital's airport to remain shut this week as airlines cancel services'.

catalysts.title: Progress (or setback) in Saudi–Iran diplomatic talks
catalysts.description: Ongoing high‑level talks between Saudi and Iranian foreign ministers that could de‑escalate or fail to restrain regional security risks.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Saudi, Iranian foreign ministers discuss regional tensions, state news agency says'.

catalysts.title: Persistent freight squeeze causing regional heavy‑oil gluts
catalysts.description: Ongoing freight capacity constraints that leave the Americas with heavy‑oil gluts while Asia and Europe scramble for barrels.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Americas have glut of heavy oil due to freight squeeze; Asia, Europe scramble for barrels'.

catalysts.title: EU consideration of windfall profit tax on oil & gas
catalysts.description: EU officials are examining a windfall profits tax on energy firms as prices rise, which could alter investor sentiment and policy risk.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'EU looking at oil and gas windfall profit tax, as energy prices soar'.
